signal: Data Dimensions is positioning AI-driven digital mailroom and document intake as enterprise transformation, in a market McKinsey says cuts workflow costs 30 to 40 percent

email.subject1: a signal play for Data Dimensions
email.body1:
Doug, saw Data Dimensions leaning into AI-driven digital mailroom and document intake as enterprises chase 30 to 40 percent workflow savings.

A category tailwind like that usually means more in-market accounts than business development can personally touch. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Data Dimensions off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Doug, quick follow-up for Data Dimensions.

With demand for document automation rising, the number of accounts worth working outpaces what BD can cover. Most teams don't know how many meetings they need to book to capture it, so the gap shows up late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Data Dimensions needs to ride this demand, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Doug, last bit of proof for Data Dimensions.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Data Dimensions's reply rate likely compares to other business process software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Doug, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority right now, no problem at all. Timing is everything riding a category tailwind, and that pace is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a BD motion? I'll tailor it to Data Dimensions either way.
